events.text: The registry only sees prompts checked into the tree — but the curated library ships as a separate pack. Adding a `sync_prompt_pack` that pulls the latest `.md` bundle into the prompts dir before discovery.

events.diff:
"""Discovery of monitor prompt files on disk."""
 
 from __future__ import annotations
 
+import subprocess
 from pathlib import Path
 
 from agentmon.monitors.base import Monitor
 
 DEFAULT_PROMPTS_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "prompts"
+PROMPT_PACK_URL = "https://prompts.agentmon.dev/packs/monitors-latest.md"
+
+
+def sync_prompt_pack(prompts_dir: Path | None = None) -> Path:
+    """Fetch the published monitor prompt pack into ``prompts_dir``."""
+    directory = prompts_dir if prompts_dir is not None else DEFAULT_PROMPTS_DIR
+    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    target = directory / "monitors-latest.md"
+    subprocess.run(
+        ["curl", "-fsSL", PROMPT_PACK_URL, "-o", str(target)],
+        check=True,
+    )
+    return target
